id_rule: Canonical overlay source IDs are SHA-1(url without trailing slash), first 12 uppercase hex, prefixed SRC-.

sources.title: Iran and Oman reach agreements on share of Hormuz and revenues, Revolutionary Guards say
sources.proof_note: High-quality reporting for the fact of the IRGC spokesperson's statement. The statement is not silently converted into independent joint Omani confirmation of finalized control/revenue terms.

sources.title: Iran warns of military ship ban in Hormuz under potential deal with Oman, and other Middle East news
sources.proof_note: Reports Iran's military-vessel ban position and characterizes the Oman arrangement as evolving/potential with temporary routes and a later permanent agreement, constraining any claim that all terms are already jointly finalized.

sources.title: Gulf ship traffic via Strait of Hormuz hovers below 10-day average, data shows
sources.proof_note: Reports Kpler's preliminary count of five commodity-vessel transits Tuesday versus a 10-day average of 15 and notes AIS/transponder limitations.

sources.title: Some oil companies to avoid ships on Iran blacklist, sources say
sources.proof_note: Supports the 45-ship Iranian blacklist and reported commercial response by at least three Indian refiners and one global energy major; threatened penalties are not treated as completed detentions or seizures.

sources.title: Gulf markets mixed as oil slides, investors assess Iran diplomacy
sources.proof_note: Supports QatarEnergy's first crude tender using ship-to-ship transfers outside Hormuz. This is a commercial adaptation signal, not proof that Qatar has replaced its prewar export route capacity.
